presets.label: The start
presets.why: High above the pad, just after the random kick: falling and drifting.

presets.label: Strongest drift
presets.why: The drift sensor reads its largest value: a gust is pushing hard.

presets.label: Closest to the boulder
presets.why: The boulder is nearest: the route sensors take over.

presets.label: Most tilted
presets.why: The lander leans furthest: steering sideways, or fighting turbulence.

presets.label: First touch
presets.why: A leg touches the ground: from here it should only cushion the landing.
